introduction: Vermont WIC provides food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support for eligible pregnant participants and families with young children.
description: Vermont WIC provides food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support for eligible pregnant participants and families with young children.

sections.who: The local WIC staff reviews residence, income, participant category and nutritional need. Caregivers can request assessment for a child younger than five.
sections.get: You receive an assigned nutrition package and related services rather than a general cash allowance.
sections.docs:
• Identity and residence information requested by staff.
  • Income or benefit information.
  • Pregnancy or child records relevant to certification.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Apply to WIC, text Apply to 844-839-8942, or contact a local office.

  2. Speak with staff

    The local team follows up on online requests to review eligibility and needs.

  3. Complete the appointment

    Confirm required records and whether an in-person or remote visit is appropriate.
sections.after: Follow benefit-use and appointment instructions. The prescreen and initial online request do not replace certification.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Vermont WIC intake; WIC services; Remote visits. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
